source.evidence: The skill button serializes Rank1, Rank2, and Rank3 UI elements; the upgrade modal serializes MaxSkillRank and the localized UI contains CURRENT SKILL RANK and MAX RANK REACHED. This establishes the maximum UI rank, not a universal per-skill cap.

nonUpgradeableSkills.evidence: Every Capacity_Tier2 and Capacity_Tier4 entry references the shared GrenadeCapacityIncrease_GA. The local curve tables have no Capacity row and local English localization gives the fixed effect 'Throwable carrying capacity is increased by 1.' It is a fixed equipped effect, not one upgrade rank, so the normalized data uses rankCap: 0 and the UI must not render an upgrade meter.
